annotations.title: Markets by gap vs last close

description: The weekend or overnight gap: markets whose home exchange is shut now (nights, weekends, holidays), by their gap vs its last close, largest first, with when real pricing resumes. Markets trading in a real session (cash, extended, overnight) come back apart under moving_now, with their move since the last close, which is not a gap. Optional group: us_stocks, etfs, indices, commodities, korea, japan, china_hk, india, fx, other.
name: get_weekend_gaps
